notes: Single-agent AI visual first pass; no human expert sign-off.

Compare future runs against this exact dataset and search pool, not the earlier 435-question pilot.

rules: AI visual first-pass review only; human expert adjudication is not claimed.
Only evaluation.jsonl is scored; quarantine.jsonl must remain excluded.
Use exactly search_pool.jsonl, rebuilding the existing UnitTypeMatcher in memory.
Pass only input.question_text and input.has_visuals to predict; never pass ground-truth labels, filenames or review notes.
Do not modify frozen v1 files. Corrections or adjudications require a new version.
Do not call changes from the old 435-question pilot an accuracy improvement; sample and search pool changed.
